description: This file contains benchmark code for various hash functions and data structures in the Abseil C++ library, including performance tests and utility functions.

classes.name: TypeErasedInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class for type-erased hash wrappers with virtual HashValue method.

classes.name: TypeErasedAbslHash
classes.description: Template struct providing a wrapper class for hashing values of type T.

methods.name: RunBenchmark
methods.description: Template function to run a benchmark for a given hash type and value.

methods.name: ODRUseFunction
methods.description: Function to ensure a function pointer is used to prevent ODR issues.

methods.name: FlatCord
methods.description: Creates and returns a flattened absl::Cord of specified size.

methods.name: FragmentedCord
methods.description: Creates and returns a fragmented absl::Cord of specified size.

methods.name: Vector
methods.description: Generates a vector of sequential values of type T.

methods.name: FastUnorderedSet
methods.description: Custom set-like structure with vector-based iteration for benchmarking hash overhead.

methods.name: FlatHashSet
methods.description: Creates a flat_hash_set with a specified number of elements.

methods.name: CodegenAbslHash
methods.description: Function to generate code for hashing a specific value.

methods.name: CodegenTypeErasedAbslHash
methods.description: Function to generate code for type-erased hash.

methods.name: PodRand
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random POD values based on entropy buffer.

methods.name: StringRand
methods.description: Generates pseudo-random string views based on entropy buffer.
